title: Report of the No Gun Ri Review
publisher_or_archive: United States Department of the Army, Washington D.C.
summary: Official military investigation conducted by the US Department of the Army following Pulitzer Prize-winning Associated Press reporting, acknowledging that in late July 1950, soldiers of the 7th Cavalry Regiment fired upon and killed an unknown number of unoffending South Korean civilian refugees gathered under a railroad bridge at No Gun Ri.
